newsitem.title: UK: Low sulphur straight run fuel "dead", Russian thin.
newsitem.headline: Low sulphur straight run fuel "dead", Russian thin.

text.p: "Dead as a dodo," said one trader on Wednesday of the European low sulphur straight run market.
Demand was again poor with most dealers believing shoppers have already bought their requirements ahead of the Christmas break. Prices eased down with crude to the low $140s fob NWE.
"Margins are not that bad, but no-one seems to want the stuff," commented one trader.

In the Mediterranean a major looked for a 25,000 tonne cargo of high sulphur straight run. But material was seen to be fairly scarce. M-40 was pegged close to $130 cif with Suez material around $125 cif. -- London Newsroom -- +44 171 542 8980
